skills.name: Find common denominator and convert fractions
skills.definition: Identify the least common denominator of two fractions and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the integer parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of fractions that have the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: When the fraction part of the minuend is less than the fraction part of the subtrahend, convert one whole unit to a fraction with the common denominator and add it to the fraction part, then proceed with subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator (LCD) of two fractions and convert them to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator and keep the denominator.

skills.name: Separate and subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers and whole numbers as a sum of a whole part and a fraction part (including whole numbers as whole + 0/d), and subtract the whole number parts.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: When the fraction part subtraction yields a negative result, reduce the whole part by 1 and add the denominator to the fraction part, then repeat the subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Find common denominator and convert fractions
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator of two fractions and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with like denominators
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions with the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Subtract whole numbers
skills.definition: Subtract the whole number parts of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: When the fraction part of the minuend is less than the fraction part of the subtrahend, subtract 1 from the whole part and add the denominator to the fraction part before subtracting.

skills.name: Simplify fraction to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its simplest form by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Convert to standard mixed number form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number as a mixed number with zero fraction, or convert an improper fraction in a mixed number to a proper mixed number by adding the whole part to the fraction.

skills.name: Subtract proper fractions with like denominators
skills.definition: Subtract numerators of proper fractions that already have the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Subtract proper fractions with unlike denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator (usually the LCD), convert both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator, then subtract the numerators.

skills.name: Subtract mixed numbers with like denominators
skills.definition: Separate whole and fraction parts, rewrite whole numbers as mixed numbers if needed, subtract whole numbers and fractions (with borrowing if the fraction part becomes negative), and combine the result. Applies to cases where the denominators of the fraction parts are already the same.

skills.name: Subtract mixed numbers with unlike denominators
skills.definition: First find a common denominator for the fraction parts, convert them to equivalent fractions, then apply the same process as subtracting mixed numbers with like denominators (including borrowing if needed).

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing the numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Find common denominator and convert fractions
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator (or a common denominator) of two fractions and convert each to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: When the fraction part of a mixed number subtraction results in a negative value, reduce the whole number part by 1 and increase the fraction part by adding the denominator to the numerator (i.e., add d/d) to make the fraction non-negative, then recompute the subtraction.

skills.name: Handle mixed numbers
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number into its whole number part and fraction part, subtract the whole number parts, and combine the resulting whole number and fraction part into a mixed number; also includes treating whole numbers as mixed numbers with a zero fraction.
